fact: Ley Núm. 5/2026 creates a Registro Único Social (RUS) within the new Instituto de Protección Social, to be designed, implemented and administered by it to hold data on families and individuals who are or may be beneficiaries of public programmes and the benefits they receive, available to the statistics institute and to institutions administering social programmes.
title: Ley Núm. 5/2026, de fecha 40 de abril, Reguladora del Sistema de Protección Social en la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
